notes:
Background: HelmForge Utility Control runs regional water treatment & distribution SCADA for three districts (~1.2M customers). Priority: replace manual SOP lookup and speed incident triage in control room. Must be fully private, FIPS-compatible, and deployable in their air-gapped NOC.

Customer constraints / asks (shorthand):
- "cannot allow external inference calls; audit trail mandatory" — CTO (direct).
- Air-gapped POC only; images handed via signed USB + offline verification.
- HSM-backed key management (FIPS 140-2/3), KMS integration must support customer HSM.
- Long-term retention for audit logs (7 years), immutable tamper-evident storage preferred.
- SSO: SAML + SCIM for user provisioning; RBAC for operator roles.
- Telemetry: SecOps requires opt-in-only, aggregated local metrics; no token-level payload shipped externally.
- Model preference: compact quantized models (4-bit) or Intel/AMD-optimized kernels; fallback to smaller deterministic model for SOP retrieval.
- Latency requirements: interactive operator prompts, target p95 < 200ms for short-turn queries; sustained load: 50 concurrent operator sessions during peak shift.
- Throughput/cost: cost secondary to reliability, but memory footprint must fit in 24–48GB per model server.
- Functional need: embeddings for SOP search, chat for operator assist, reranking for multiple-sensor alert prioritization.

Evaluation plan: 8 week POC (staging in air-gapped testbed). Acceptance criteria: p95 latency <200ms for defined prompts, <1% failure rate across network partitions, verified signed binaries, documented patch/rollback procedure.

Technical notes / engineering questions:
- Need a documented image transfer & verification flow (hash signing + chain-of-custody).
- Clarify compatibility matrix for their CPU/GPU fleet (NVIDIA A100 not present; currently DGX-like and some Xeon+Mellanox).
- KV cache behavior: default to disabled for PII/SOP content unless explicitly approved.
- SE asked about offline eval harness and synthetic prompt set for regression detection.

Commercial notes:
- Budgeting: enterprise procurement cycles slow; expected approvals to go through IT security board in April. Forecasted close 2026-05 if POC successful.
- Estimated ARR range provided to legal for draft SOW.

Stated next steps: schedule onsite network/security review (week of 2026-03-17), finalize POC image transfer SOP, provide draft service statement of work and FCA for HSM integration.

Attachments referenced: pricing deck, private-deploy whitepaper, POC runbook (links stored in Drive).
